rationale: EO 12753 (March 8, 1991, 56 FR 10501) extends the section 126a(2) Atomic Energy Act period only to March 10, 1992. The held text of EO 12791 (March 9, 1992, 57 FR 8717; cited from the American Presidency Project capture, with the same sentence in the held Federal Register text) states that Executive Order No. 12753 shall be superseded on the effective date of that order, which is a later order expressly superseding EO 12753 without limiting words; EO 12791 gives no other effective date, so March 9, 1992 is used, with the order's own March 10, 1992 period end as the latest alternative. The single history observation, the Federal Register disposition note recording that it supersedes EO 12706 of March 9, 1990 and is superseded by EO 12791 of March 9, 1992, agrees. No revival or earlier ending is held. The order had no force on 2026-10-14. Recommended: no.
